btc_timing_qualification: Recorded transfers constrain earliest modeled operational availability. They do not identify the time or price of BTC liquidation or Jump UST purchases. The pooled LFG account does not reproduce exchange custody. Late timestamps add a one-hour assumed operational delay, not a verified latest-availability bound.
btc_net_budget_attribution: Preserves 80,081 spendable BTC and 313 retained from the 80,394 BTC initial reserve. Attribute 22,189 to the first Jump transfer; allocate 24,687 of the second reported 30,000 after reserving 5,000 for later Jump-to-TFL transfers and 313 retained. Attribute 28,205 of the reported 28,206 TFL transfer to reconcile the one-BTC rounding mismatch in published whole-BTC figures. Later 4,000 and 1,000 BTC tranches are transfers within this budget, not additional reserves. This is a net-budget allocation, not evidence that these subtractions occurred at a particular transfer time.
